function.name: AskQuestion
function.description: Ask the user one or more multiple-choice questions and wait for the answers. Use it only when a decision is genuinely the user's and cannot be settled from the request, the code or a sensible default. The user can always type an answer of their own.

allow_multiple.description: Whether several options may be chosen. Defaults to false.

label.description: The choice as the user reads it.

prompt.description: The question as the user reads it.

title.description: Optional heading shown above the questions.

function.name: CallMcpTool
function.description: Call a tool exposed by one of the user's MCP servers. Look up the server and tool name, and the tool's argument schema, with GetMcpTools first when you do not already know them.

arguments.description: Arguments matching the tool's input schema.

description.description: A few words on why this call is made, shown to the user.

requestSmartModeApproval.description: Ask the user to approve this call explicitly.

smartModeBlockReason.description: Why the call needs approval, when asking for it.

toolName.description: The tool's name on that server.

function.name: SembleSearch
function.description: Search an indexed repository by meaning.

content.description: Which kind of files to search.

function.name: SembleFindRelated
function.description: Find code related to a given line of a file.

content.description: Which kind of files to search.

function.name: CreatePlan
function.description: Present an implementation plan for the user to review and confirm. Use it in Plan mode once research is done; nothing is changed until the user accepts.

name.description: A short name for the plan.

overview.description: One or two sentences on what the plan achieves.

plan.description: The plan in Markdown: concrete steps, the files they touch, and why.

todos.description: The plan's steps as a checklist.

function.name: Delete
function.description: Delete a file. Fails quietly when the file does not exist or the operation is refused.

path.description: The file to delete, absolute or relative to the workspace.

function.name: EditNotebook
function.description: Edit one cell of a Jupyter notebook, or insert a new cell. To change a cell, give enough of its current text in old_string to identify the change uniquely; to add a cell, set is_new_cell and leave old_string empty.

cell_idx.description: 0-based index of the cell to edit, or where the new cell goes.

cell_language.description: The cell's language, such as python, markdown or raw.

is_new_cell.description: Whether to insert a new cell at cell_idx.

new_string.description: The replacement text, or the new cell's contents.

old_string.description: Existing text to replace; empty for a new cell.

function.name: FetchMcpResource
function.description: Read a resource from one of the user's MCP servers, optionally saving it to a file.

downloadPath.description: Optional workspace path to save the resource to.

requestSmartModeApproval.description: Ask the user to approve this read explicitly.

smartModeBlockReason.description: Why the read needs approval, when asking for it.

function.name: GenerateImage
function.description: Generate an image from a description and save it in the workspace.

description.description: What the image shows, in detail.

filename.description: Optional file name for the image.

reference_image_paths.description: Optional images to base the result on.

function.name: GetMcpTools
function.description: List the tools the user's MCP servers expose, with their argument schemas. Filter by server, tool name or a pattern to keep the list short.

pattern.description: Only tools whose name or description matches this text.

function.name: Glob
function.description: Find files whose paths match a glob pattern, newest first. Patterns without a leading **/ are searched recursively anyway.

glob_pattern.description: The pattern, such as **/*.ts or src/**/test_*.py.

target_directory.description: Directory to search in; the workspace when omitted.

function.name: Grep
function.description: Search file contents with a regular expression (ripgrep syntax). Prefer it over running grep or rg in the shell. Results respect .gitignore.

-A.description: Lines of context after each match (content mode).

-B.description: Lines of context before each match (content mode).

-C.description: Lines of context around each match (content mode).

glob.description: Only files matching this glob, such as *.rs.

head_limit.description: Return at most this many lines or entries.

multiline.description: Let patterns span lines; . also matches newlines.

offset.description: Skip this many lines or entries first.

output_mode.description: content shows matching lines, files_with_matches only paths (the default), count the number of matches per file.

path.description: File or directory to search; the workspace when omitted.

type.description: Only files of this ripgrep type, such as js or py.

function.name: Read
function.description: Read a file. Lines come back numbered as LINE_NUMBER|CONTENT. Large files can be read in parts with offset and limit. Images are returned as images. Reading a file that does not exist reports an error.

path.description: The file, absolute or relative to the workspace.

function.name: ReadLints
function.description: Read the editor's current diagnostics (lint and type errors) for files or directories, or for the whole workspace when no paths are given. Use it after editing to check your changes.

paths.description: Files or directories to report on.

function.name: Shell
function.description: Run a command in a shell in the user's workspace. Each call starts in the workspace root unless working_directory is set. Quote paths that contain spaces. Prefer the dedicated tools for reading, searching and editing files. A command that keeps running past block_until_ms moves to the background; its output stays readable in the terminal files.

block_until_ms.description: How long to wait for the command before moving it to the background; 0 starts it in the background at once.

description.description: A few words on what the command does, shown to the user.

debounce_ms.description: Wait this long after a match before notifying.

notify_on_output.description: Notify you when background output matches a pattern.

request_smart_mode_approval.description: Ask the user to approve this command explicitly.

smart_mode_block_reason.description: Why the command needs approval, when asking for it.

working_directory.description: Directory to run the command in.

required_permissions.description: Extra sandbox permissions the command needs: full_network for network access, all for no sandbox.

function.name: StrReplace
function.description: Replace text in a file. old_string must match the file exactly, including whitespace, and must be unique unless replace_all is set. Read the file before editing it. To create a file use Write.

new_string.description: The text to put in its place; it must differ from old_string.

replace_all.description: Replace every occurrence instead of exactly one.

function.name: SwitchMode
function.description: Ask to switch the conversation to another mode, such as from Agent to Plan when the task needs a plan first. The user confirms the switch.

explanation.description: Why switching helps, shown to the user.

target_mode_id.description: The mode to switch to, such as plan or agent.

function.name: Task
function.description: Start a subagent that works on a bounded task on its own and reports back. Give it a complete, self-contained prompt: it does not see this conversation. Use explore for read-only investigation and generalPurpose for work that changes files. Background subagents report when they finish; do not wait for them.

cloud_base_branch.description: Branch a cloud subagent starts from.

description.description: A short title for the task, shown to the user.

file_attachments.description: Files to hand to the subagent.

interrupt.description: Interrupt the resumed subagent's current work.

model.description: Optional model for the subagent; the current one when omitted.

prompt.description: Everything the subagent needs to know to do the task.

resume.description: Identifier of an earlier subagent to continue.

run_in_background.description: Run without waiting; you are notified when it finishes.

function.name: TodoWrite
function.description: Create or update the task list shown to the user. Use it for work with several steps: keep exactly one item in_progress while working, and mark items completed as soon as they are done.

merge.description: true updates the items with matching ids and keeps the rest; false replaces the list.

function.name: UpdateCurrentStep
function.description: Tell the parent agent what you are working on now, in a few words.

completed_subtitle.description: A short note on what the finished step achieved.

final_summary.description: When everything is done, a short summary of the result.

function.name: WebFetch
function.description: Fetch a web page and return its readable content as Markdown. The user may be asked to approve the fetch. Only public http(s) addresses can be fetched.

requestSmartModeApproval.description: Ask the user to approve this fetch explicitly.

smartModeBlockReason.description: Why the fetch needs approval, when asking for it.

function.name: WebSearch
function.description: Search the web for current information: recent releases, documentation, error messages, facts that may have changed. Returns titles, links and snippets. The user may be asked to approve the search.

explanation.description: Why the search helps, shown to the user.

search_term.description: What to search for; be specific and include versions or dates when they matter.

function.name: Write
function.description: Write a file, creating it or replacing all of its contents. Read an existing file before overwriting it, and prefer StrReplace for changing part of a file.
